name: Honey Mustard Chicken Tenders with Broccoli Orange Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Using a paper towel, lightly coat a large baking dish with oil.
instructions.secondary_message: about 1 ½ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Grate 3/4 cup of Parmesan. In a medium bowl, mix together Parmesan, bread crumbs, salt, pepper, and paprika.
instructions.secondary_message:
84 g Parmesan cheese
1 ½ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper
⅜ tsp paprika

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, mix together Dijon, honey, and oil.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tbsp Dijon mustard
4 ½ tbsp honey
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Slice chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Cut each fillet into strips.
One by one, dip chicken strips in mustard mixture, then coat in bread crumb mixture, and place in baking dish.
Place in the oven and bake, turning over halfway through, until tenders are golden brown, 15-20 minutes.
Peel and mince garlic. In a small bowl, prepare sauce by mixing together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the slaw), Dijon, and honey. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
6 tbsp Dijon mustard
6 tbsp honey

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together remaining garlic, lemon juice, oil, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemon
4 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broccoli slaw to bowl with dressing. Wash, peel, and medium dice oranges. Add to bowl and toss salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (340 g) pkg broccoli slaw
3 oranges

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place chicken tenders and broccoli slaw on a plate and have honey mustard sauce on the side. Enjoy!
